name: Spiritual Perfection
overview: Scripture calls believers to pursue spiritual perfection, exemplified by the call in Matthew 5:48 to be perfect as the heavenly Father is perfect. This maturity is described in Ephesians 4:13 as growing into the fullness and stature of Christ through unity in faith and knowledge. The journey toward perfection is ongoing, as Paul acknowledges in Philippians 3:12 that he has not yet attained it but continues to strive forward. Trials and patience play a vital role in this process, with James 1:2 and 1:4 teaching that enduring temptations produces a completeness and maturity that leaves believers lacking nothing.
